name: Leviticus
title: Leviticus — Holy God, Holy People
tagline: How sinners draw near without being consumed.
audience: Priests and people of the covenant.
purpose: Teach holiness, sacrifice, and clean approach to Yahweh.
christ: Once-for-all sacrifice and High Priest (Hebrews); Day of Atonement fulfilled.
spirit: Holiness that the Spirit later writes on hearts (new covenant).
jesus_in_this_book: Once-for-all sacrifice and High Priest (Hebrews); Day of Atonement fulfilled.
how_to_read: Not primitive bloodlust — holy love making a way.
watchman_charge: Do not despise holiness. The God who saves is still holy.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
